text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Oguri Cap is interviewed by several reporters, but feels ill at ease because she isn't able to answer the questions as well as she wants.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Tamamo Cross, having debuted a little earlier than Oguri Cap, gives her some advice.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: After coming to an important realization, Oguri Cap makes an impressive declaration at a press conference.
